local espDrawings = {}

local function createESP(player)
    if espDrawings[player] then return end
    local drawings = {
        Box = Drawing.new("Square"),
        Tracer = Drawing.new("Line")
    }
    drawings.Box.Visible = false
    drawings.Box.Thickness = 1.5
    drawings.Box.Filled = false
    drawings.Tracer.Visible = false
    drawings.Tracer.Thickness = 1.5
    espDrawings[player] = drawings
end

local function removeESP(player)
    if espDrawings[player] then
        for _, drawing in pairs(espDrawings[player]) do
            drawing:Remove()
        end
        espDrawings[player] = nil
    end
end

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(removeESP)

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player ~= LocalPlayer then
            if not espDrawings[player] then
                createESP(player)
            end
            
            local drawings = espDrawings[player]
            local char = player.Character
            local rootPart = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local humanoid = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            
            local isTeammate = NexusConfig.TeamCheck and player.Team == LocalPlayer.Team
            
            if NexusConfig.ESP_Enabled and char and rootPart and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 and not isTeammate then
                local vector, onScreen = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(rootPart.Position)
                
                if onScreen then
                    if NexusConfig.Box_Enabled then
                        local head = char:FindFirstChild("Head")
                        if head then
                            local headPos = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(head.Position + Vector3.new(0, 0.5, 0))
                            local legPos = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(rootPart.Position - Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))
                            local height = math.abs(headPos.Y - legPos.Y)
                            local width = height / 2
                            
                            drawings.Box.Size = Vector2.new(width, height)
                            drawings.Box.Position = Vector2.new(vector.X - width / 2, headPos.Y)
                            drawings.Box.Color = NexusConfig.ESP_Color
                            drawings.Box.Visible = true
                        end
                    else
                        drawings.Box.Visible = false
                    end
                    
                    if NexusConfig.Tracers_Enabled then
                        local viewportSize = Camera.ViewportSize
                        local origin = Vector2.new(viewportSize.X / 2, viewportSize.Y)
                        
                        drawings.Tracer.From = origin
                        drawings.Tracer.To = Vector2.new(vector.X, vector.Y)
                        drawings.Tracer.Color = NexusConfig.ESP_Color
                        drawings.Tracer.Visible = true
                    else
                        drawings.Tracer.Visible = false
                    end
                else
                    drawings.Box.Visible = false
                    drawings.Tracer.Visible = false
                end
            else
                drawings.Box.Visible = false
                drawings.Tracer.Visible = false
            end
        end
    end
end)

local function findPlayer(query)
    if not query or query == "" then return nil end
    query = string.lower(query)
    
    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if string.lower(player.Name) == query or string.lower(player.DisplayName) == query then
            return player
        end
    end
    
    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        local nameLower = string.lower(player.Name)
        local displayLower = string.lower(player.DisplayName)
        if string.sub(nameLower, 1, #query) == query or string.sub(displayLower, 1, #query) == query then
            return player

local function __NA_SPLIT_PART_VALID(source, meta, name)
	if type(source) ~= "string" or source == "" then return false end
	local checks = type(meta) == "table" and meta.integrity or nil
	if checks == nil then return true end
	local check = type(checks) == "table" and checks[name] or nil
	if type(check) ~= "table" or #source ~= check[1] or type(check[2]) ~= "number" then return false end
	local a, b = 1, 0
	local nextYield = os.clock() + 0.004
	for start = 1, #source, 4096 do
		for index = start, math.min(start + 4095, #source) do
			a += string.byte(source, index)
			b += a
		end
		a %= 65521
		b %= 65521
		if start + 4095 < #source and os.clock() >= nextYield then
			__NA_SPLIT_YIELD()
			nextYield = os.clock() + 0.004
		end
	end
	return b * 65536 + a == check[2]
end

local function __NA_SPLIT_CACHE_LOADER(meta)
	if type(meta) ~= "table" or type(meta.loader_version) ~= "string" then return end
	if type(writefile) ~= "function" then
		return
	end

	local host = (type(getgenv) == "function" and getgenv()) or _G or {}
	local state = type(host) == "table" and rawget(host, "__NamelessAdminRuntimeState") or nil
	local sourceTag = __NA_SPLIT_SOURCE_TAG
	if sourceTag ~= "Source.lua" and sourceTag ~= "NA testing.lua" then
		return
	end

	local roots = {
		"NA-split-gitlab/";
		"Nameless-Admin/NA-split-gitlab/";
		"Nameless Admin/NA-split-gitlab/";
	}
	local root = roots[1]
	if type(isfile) == "function" then
		for _, candidate in roots do
			local ok, exists = pcall(isfile, candidate.."common/manifest.lua")
			if ok and exists then
				root = candidate
				break
			end
		end
	end

	local cachePath = root..sourceTag
	local versionPath = root.."."..sourceTag:gsub("[^%w]+", "_")..".version"
	if type(readfile) == "function" then
		local okVersion, cachedVersion = pcall(readfile, versionPath)
		local okLoader, exists = false, false
		if type(isfile) == "function" then okLoader, exists = pcall(isfile, cachePath) end
		if okVersion and cachedVersion == meta.loader_version and okLoader and exists then
			return
		end
	end

	local remoteName = sourceTag:gsub(" ", "%%20")
	local loaderRoot = __NA_SPLIT_REMOTE_ROOT:gsub("NA%-split/[^/]+/$", "")
	if loaderRoot == __NA_SPLIT_REMOTE_ROOT then return end
	local url = loaderRoot..remoteName.."?na_loader="..meta.loader_version
	local requestFn = type(host) == "table" and (rawget(host, "request") or rawget(host, "http_request")) or nil
	local synTable = type(host) == "table" and rawget(host, "syn") or nil
	if type(requestFn) ~= "function" and type(synTable) == "table" then
		requestFn = synTable.request
	end

	local source
	if type(requestFn) == "function" then
		local ok, response = pcall(requestFn, { Method = "GET"; Url = url; })
		local status = type(response) == "table" and tonumber(response.StatusCode or response.statusCode or response.Status) or nil
		local body = type(response) == "table" and (response.Body or response.body) or nil
		if ok and type(body) == "string" and body ~= "" and (not status or status < 400) then
			source = body
		end
	end

	if not source and (type(game) == "userdata" or type(game) == "table") then
		local ok, body = pcall(function()
			return game:HttpGet(url)
		end)
		if ok and type(body) == "string" and body ~= "" then
			source = body
		end
	end
	if not source then
		return
	end

	local loader = type(host) == "table" and rawget(host, "loadstring") or nil
	loader = loader or loadstring or load
	if type(loader) ~= "function" then
		return
	end
	local okCompile, chunk = pcall(loader, source, "@"..sourceTag)
	if not okCompile or type(chunk) ~= "function" then
		return
	end

	if type(makefolder) == "function" then
		local parent = root:gsub("/$", "")
		local current = ""
		for segment in parent:gmatch("[^/]+") do
			current = current == "" and segment or current.."/"..segment
			pcall(makefolder, current)
		end
	end
	if pcall(writefile, cachePath, source) then
		pcall(writefile, versionPath, meta.loader_version)
	end
end


local function __NA_SPLIT_CLEAR_LEGACY()
	if type(isfolder) ~= "function" or type(delfolder) ~= "function" then return 0 end
	local function clean(root, path, depth)
		if depth > 16 then return end
		local ok, exists = pcall(isfolder, path)
		if not ok or not exists then return end
		if type(listfiles) == "function" then
			local listed, items = pcall(listfiles, path)
			if listed and type(items) == "table" then
				for _, entry in items do
					local name = tostring(entry):gsub("\\", "/"):gsub("^%./", ""):gsub("/+$", "")
					if name:sub(1, #root + 1) == root.."/"
						and not name:find("/../", 1, true) and name:sub(-3) ~= "/.." then
						local valid, isDir = pcall(isfolder, name)
						if valid and isDir then
							clean(root, name, depth + 1)
						elseif type(delfile) == "function" then
							pcall(delfile, name)
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
		pcall(delfolder, path)
	end
	local removed = 0
	for _, root in { "NA-split", "Nameless-Admin/NA-split", "Nameless Admin/NA-split" } do
		local ok, exists = pcall(isfolder, root)
		if ok and exists then
			clean(root, root, 0)
			local checked, remains = pcall(isfolder, root)
			if checked and not remains then removed += 1 end
		end
	end
	return removed
end

	local path = __NA_SPLIT_MODULE_PATH(key)
	if not path or type(readfile) ~= "function" or type(writefile) ~= "function" or type(source) ~= "string" then return false end
	if type(url) ~= "string" or url == "" or url:find("[\r\n]") then return false end
	local data = url.."\n"..source
	if not __NA_SPLIT_MODULE_SOURCE(data, url) then return false end
	local okOld, old = pcall(readfile, path)
	if okOld and old == data then return true end
	if type(makefolder) == "function" then
		local current = ""
		for segment in (__NA_SPLIT_CACHE_ROOT..".modules"):gmatch("[^/]+") do
			current = current == "" and segment or current.."/"..segment
			pcall(makefolder, current)
		end
	end
	if okOld and __NA_SPLIT_MODULE_SOURCE(old, url) then
		if not pcall(writefile, path..".backup", old) then return false end
		local okBackup, backup = pcall(readfile, path..".backup")
		if not okBackup or backup ~= old then return false end
	end
	if not pcall(writefile, path, data) then return false end
	local okRead, written = pcall(readfile, path)
	return okRead and written == data
end

local __NA_SPLIT_ENV

local function __NA_SPLIT_REMEMBER(name, source)
	if __NA_LAZY_FILES[name] then return end

	__NA_LAZY_ORDER[#__NA_LAZY_ORDER + 1] = name
	while #__NA_LAZY_ORDER > 4 do
		__NA_LAZY_FILES[table.remove(__NA_LAZY_ORDER, 1)] = nil

local function __NA_SPLIT_LAZY_SOURCE(name)
	if __NA_LAZY_FILES[name] then return __NA_LAZY_FILES[name] end

	if not source then
		local meta = __NA_SPLIT_REMOTE_META or __NA_SPLIT_LOCAL_META
		if type(meta) ~= "table" then error("Missing common source manifest", 0) end
		source = __NA_SPLIT_READ_PART(name)
	end

local function __NA_SPLIT_READ_DEFER()
	local meta = __NA_SPLIT_REMOTE_META or __NA_SPLIT_LOCAL_META
	if not __NA_SPLIT_LIMITED or not __NA_SPLIT_PART_FINGERPRINT(meta, "deferred.lua") then return end

	if not ok then return end

	if not valid then return end

		__NA_SPLIT_DEFER = data

local function __NA_SPLIT_PREPARE(source, name)
	local rows = __NA_SPLIT_DEFER and __NA_SPLIT_DEFER[name]
	if type(rows) ~= "table" or #rows == 0 then return source end
	local out, pos = {}, 1
	for _, row in rows do
		if type(row) ~= "table" then return source end
		local first, last, cut, line, prefix = table.unpack(row, 1, 5)
		if type(first) ~= "number" or type(last) ~= "number" or type(cut) ~= "number"
			or type(line) ~= "number" or type(prefix) ~= "string" or first < pos or last < first or last > #source
			or first % 1 ~= 0 or last % 1 ~= 0 or cut % 1 ~= 0 or line % 1 ~= 0
			or (cut ~= 0 and (cut < first or cut > last)) then return source end
		out[#out + 1] = source:sub(pos, first - 1)
		local label = "NA-split/common/"..name..":"..tostring(line)
		out[#out + 1] = prefix.."__NA_SPLIT_LAZY("..string.format("%q, %d, %d, %d, %q", name, first, last, cut, label)..")"
		pos = last + 1
	end
	out[#out + 1] = source:sub(pos)
	__NA_SPLIT_REMEMBER(name, source)
	return table.concat(out)
end

local function __NA_SPLIT_LAZY(name, first, last, cut, label)
	local fn, busy
	return function(...)
		while busy and coroutine.status(busy) ~= "dead" do task.wait() end
		if not fn then
			busy = coroutine.running()
			local ok, result = pcall(function()
				local source = __NA_SPLIT_LAZY_SOURCE(name)
				local body = cut > 0 and "function"..source:sub(cut, last) or source:sub(first, last)
				local env = __NA_SPLIT_ENV

				env = type(boot) == "table" and boot.runtimeEnv or env
				local chunk = __NA_SPLIT_LOAD_PART("return "..body, label, env)
				local value = chunk()
				if type(value) ~= "function" then error("Invalid deferred function: "..label, 0) end
				return value
			end)
			busy = nil
			if not ok then error(result, 0) end
			fn = result
		end
		return fn(...)
	end
end

		for key, child in next, value do

			elseif type(child) == "thread" and child ~= current and coroutine.status(child) ~= "dead" and type(task) == "table" then
				cancel(child)
			elseif type(child) == "table" then
				clean(child)
			end
			if type(key) == "thread" and key ~= current and coroutine.status(key) ~= "dead" and type(task) == "table" then cancel(key) end
		end
	end
	for _, name in { "NAmanage", "NAStuff", "NAjobs", "NAgui", "NAUIMANAGER", "NAindex", "NAAssetsLoading" } do clean(rawget(runtime, name)) end
	local stuff = rawget(runtime, "NAStuff")
	if type(stuff) == "table" and typeof(stuff.NASCREENGUI) == "Instance" then
		pcall(function() stuff.NASCREENGUI:Destroy() end)
	end
	local assets = rawget(runtime, "NAAssetsLoading")
	if type(assets) == "table" and typeof(assets.ui) == "Instance" then
		pcall(function() assets.ui:Destroy() end)
	end
	if type(boot) == "table" and type(boot.privateRoot) == "table" then
		local root = boot.privateRoot
		local owned = rawget(runtime, "_na_env")
		local ownsRoot = type(owned) == "table" and root.testing == owned
		local protector = rawget(runtime, "__NAUIProtector")
		if type(protector) ~= "table" and ownsRoot then protector = root.uiProtector end
		if type(protector) == "table" and (ownsRoot or root.uiProtector ~= protector) then
			if type(protector.destroy) == "function" then pcall(protector.destroy) end
			if root.uiProtector == protector then root.uiProtector = nil end
		end
		if ownsRoot then

local function getClimbSurface()
	local char, hrp = getParts()
	local params = RaycastParams.new()
	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { char }
	params.IgnoreWater = true

	local up = Workspace:Raycast(hrp.Position, Vector3.new(0, 4.8, 0), params)  
	if up and up.Normal.Y < -0.45 then  
		return up, "ceiling"  
	end  

	local flatLook = Vector3.new(hrp.CFrame.LookVector.X, 0, hrp.CFrame.LookVector.Z)  
	if flatLook.Magnitude > 0.01 then  
		local lip = Workspace:Raycast(hrp.Position + Vector3.new(0, 1.4, 0), flatLook.Unit * 2.4 + Vector3.new(0, 3.2, 0), params)  
		if lip and lip.Normal.Y < -0.4 then  
			return lip, "ceiling"  
		end  
	end  

	local directions = {  
		hrp.CFrame.LookVector,  
		-hrp.CFrame.LookVector,  
		hrp.CFrame.RightVector,  
		-hrp.CFrame.RightVector,  
	}  
	local closestResult = nil  
	local closestDistance = math.huge  
	for _, direction in ipairs(directions) do  
		local result = Workspace:Raycast(hrp.Position, direction * 3.6, params)  
		if result and math.abs(result.Normal.Y) < 0.55 then  
			local distance = (result.Position - hrp.Position).Magnitude  
			if distance < closestDistance then  
				closestDistance = distance  
				closestResult = result  
			end  
		end  
	end  
	if closestResult then  
		return closestResult, "wall"  
	end  
	return nil, nil
end

local function startClimb()
	if climbing or not climbEnabled then return end
	local _, hrp, hum = getParts()
	local wall = getClimbSurface()
	if not wall then return end
	climbing = true
	hum.AutoRotate = false
	hum.PlatformStand = false
	local animator = getAnimator(hum)
	local anim = Instance.new("Animation")
	anim.AnimationId = CLIMB_ANIM
	climbTrack = animator:LoadAnimation(anim)
	climbTrack.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action4
	climbTrack.Looped = true
	climbTrack:Play(0.1)
	hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Climbing)
	climbAttachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
	climbAttachment.Name = "SpiderClimbAttachment"
	climbAttachment.Parent = hrp
	climbVelocity = Instance.new("LinearVelocity")
	climbVelocity.Name = "SpiderClimbVelocity"
	climbVelocity.MaxForce = math.huge
	climbVelocity.RelativeTo = Enum.ActuatorRelativeTo.World
	climbVelocity.VectorVelocity = Vector3.zero
	climbVelocity.Attachment0 = climbAttachment
	climbVelocity.Parent = hrp
	climbAlign = Instance.new("AlignOrientation")
	climbAlign.Name = "SpiderClimbOrientation"
	climbAlign.Mode = Enum.OrientationAlignmentMode.OneAttachment
	climbAlign.MaxTorque = math.huge
	climbAlign.Responsiveness = 30
	climbAlign.RigidityEnabled = false
	climbAlign.Attachment0 = climbAttachment
	climbAlign.Parent = hrp
	climbConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
		if not climbing then return end
		if not hrp.Parent then stopClimb(); return end
		local surface, kind = getClimbSurface()
		if not surface then stopClimb(); return end
		local normal = surface.Normal
		local camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
		local cameraForward = camera.CFrame.LookVector
		local cameraRight = camera.CFrame.RightVector
		local move = hum.MoveDirection
		if kind == "ceiling" then
			hum.PlatformStand = true
			local planar = Vector3.new(move.X, 0, move.Z)
			local speed = 0
			if planar.Magnitude > 0.08 then
				planar = planar.Unit
				speed = 12
			else
				planar = Vector3.new(cameraForward.X, 0, cameraForward.Z)
				if planar.Magnitude > 0.01 then
					planar = planar.Unit
				else
					planar = Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)
				end
			end
			climbVelocity.VectorVelocity = planar * speed + Vector3.new(0, 7, 0)
			climbAlign.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.zero, Vector3.new(0, 1, 0), planar)
		else
			hum.PlatformStand = false
			local horizontal = Vector3.new(move.X, 0, move.Z)
			local vertical = 0
			if horizontal.Magnitude > 0.05 then vertical = horizontal:Dot(cameraForward) end
			local up = Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
			local wallRight = cameraRight - normal * cameraRight:Dot(normal)
			if wallRight.Magnitude > 0.01 then wallRight = wallRight.Unit end
			climbVelocity.VectorVelocity = up * vertical * 9 + wallRight * move:Dot(wallRight) * 8 - normal * 4
			local facing = -normal
			local look = Vector3.new(facing.X, 0, facing.Z)
			if look.Magnitude > 0.01 then climbAlign.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.zero, look.Unit) end
		end
		if hum:GetState() ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.Climbing then hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Climbing) end
	end)
end

local function createGroundWeb(position, normal)
	local part = Instance.new("Part")
	part.Name = "GroundWeb"
	part.Anchored = true
	part.CanCollide = false
	part.CanTouch = false
	part.CanQuery = false
	part.Transparency = 1
	part.Size = Vector3.new(7, 0.05, 7)
	local up = normal.Unit
	local forward = Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)
	if math.abs(up:Dot(forward)) > 0.95 then forward = Vector3.new(1, 0, 0) end
	forward = (forward - up * forward:Dot(up)).Unit
	part.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(position + up * 0.035, position + up * 0.035 + forward, up)
	part.Parent = Workspace
	local decal = Instance.new("Decal")
	decal.Texture = GROUND_WEB_TEXTURE

local function fireWebProjectile(char, startPosition, direction)
	local projectile = Instance.new("Part")
	projectile.Name = "WebShotProjectile"
	projectile.Anchored = true
	projectile.CanCollide = false
	projectile.CanTouch = false
	projectile.CanQuery = false
	projectile.Transparency = 1
	projectile.Size = Vector3.new(0.35, 0.35, 0.35)
	projectile.Position = startPosition
	projectile.Parent = Workspace
	table.insert(webShotObjects, projectile)
	local frontAttachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
	frontAttachment.Parent = projectile
	local webVisual = Instance.new("Part")
	webVisual.Name = "WebShotVisual"
	webVisual.Anchored = true
	webVisual.CanCollide = false
	webVisual.CanTouch = false
	webVisual.CanQuery = false
	webVisual.Transparency = 1
	webVisual.Size = Vector3.new(0.2, 0.2, 0.2)
	webVisual.Position = startPosition - direction * 0.8
	webVisual.Parent = Workspace
	table.insert(webShotObjects, webVisual)
	local backAttachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
	backAttachment.Parent = webVisual
	local beam = Instance.new("Beam")
	beam.Attachment0 = backAttachment
	beam.Attachment1 = frontAttachment
	beam.Width0 = 0.9
	beam.Width1 = 0.9
	beam.Texture = WEB_SHOT_TEXTURE
	beam.TextureMode = Enum.TextureMode.Wrap
	beam.TextureLength = 1
	beam.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255))
	beam.LightEmission = 1
	beam.FaceCamera = true
	beam.Segments = 4
	beam.Parent = webVisual
	table.insert(webShotObjects, beam)
	local velocity = direction.Unit * 75
	local position = startPosition
	local previousPosition = position
	local elapsed = 0
	local gravity = Vector3.new(0, -120, 0)
	local connection
	connection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
		if not projectile.Parent then connection:Disconnect(); return end
		elapsed += dt
		velocity += gravity * dt
		previousPosition = position
		position += velocity * dt
		local params = RaycastParams.new()
		params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
		params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { char, projectile, webVisual }
		params.IgnoreWater = true
		local result = Workspace:Raycast(previousPosition, position - previousPosition, params)
		if result and result.Normal.Y > 0.45 then
			connection:Disconnect()
			projectile.Position = result.Position
			createGroundWeb(result.Position, result.Normal)
			projectile:Destroy()
			webVisual:Destroy()
			return
		end
		projectile.Position = position
		webVisual.Position = position - direction.Unit * 0.8
		if elapsed > 2.5 then
			connection:Disconnect()
			projectile:Destroy()
			webVisual:Destroy()
		end
	end)
end

local SoundService = game:GetService("SoundService")

--// CHILL MUSIC PLAYLIST (Roblox Sound IDs)

    "rbxassetid://1839841807",  -- Chill Lofi 2

    "rbxassetid://1848354536"   -- Soft Aesthetic

musicSound.Name = "BackgroundChillMusic"
musicSound.Volume = 0.5
musicSound.Looped = false
musicSound.Parent = SoundService

local remainingPlaylist = {}

-- Function to shuffle table randomly (Fisher-Yates Shuffle)
local function shufflePlaylist()
    remainingPlaylist = {}
    for _, soundId in ipairs(chillPlaylist) do
        table.insert(remainingPlaylist, soundId)
    end
    
    for i = #remainingPlaylist, 2, -1 do
        local j = math.random(i)
        remainingPlaylist[i], remainingPlaylist[j] = remainingPlaylist[j], remainingPlaylist[i]
    end
    print("[Music Player] Playlist shuffled. " .. tostring(#remainingPlaylist) .. " tracks loaded.")
end

-- Function to play next unique song
local function playNextSong()
    -- Refill and shuffle if playlist is empty or all tracks played
    if #remainingPlaylist == 0 then
        shufflePlaylist()
    end
    
    -- Pick the top track and remove it from the pool to prevent repeats
    local nextTrack = table.remove(remainingPlaylist, 1)
    
    musicSound.SoundId = nextTrack
    musicSound:Play()
    print("[Music Player] Now playing: " .. nextTrack)
end

-- Play next track automatically when the current one ends
musicSound.Ended:Connect(playNextSong)

-- Start the music player
playNextSong()

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
	if not isFlying then return end
	
	local seat = getVehicleSeat()
	local targetPart = seat or getTorso()
	if not targetPart then return end
	
	local realSpeed = speed * 50
	local cameraCF = camera.CFrame
	local cameraLook = cameraCF.LookVector   -- 完整的 3D 視線方向 (含 X, Y, Z)
	local cameraRight = cameraCF.RightVector -- 完整的 3D 側向方向 (含 X, Y, Z)

	local bg = targetPart:FindFirstChild("FlyGyro")
	local bv = targetPart:FindFirstChild("FlyVelocity")
	
	if not bg or not bv then
		setupFlyPhysics()
		return
	end

	local moveDir = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
	local isMoving = false

	-- 直接使用完整 3D 向量，實現 XYZ 軸自由飛行
	if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then moveDir = moveDir + cameraLook isMoving = true end
	if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then moveDir = moveDir - cameraLook isMoving = true end
	if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) then moveDir = moveDir - cameraRight isMoving = true end
	if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then moveDir = moveDir + cameraRight isMoving = true end

	-- 支援手把或移動端搖桿方向
	local hum = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not isMoving and hum and hum.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0.1 then
		local rawDir = hum.MoveDirection
		local relForward = rawDir:Dot(cameraLook)
		local relRight = rawDir:Dot(cameraRight)
		moveDir = (cameraLook * relForward + cameraRight * relRight)
		isMoving = true
	end

	local flyVel = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
	if isMoving and moveDir.Magnitude > 0 then
		flyVel = moveDir.Unit * realSpeed
	end

	-- 上下控制鍵（Space / LeftShift 或 UI 按鈕）
	local verticalOffset = 0
	if moveUp or UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) then
		verticalOffset = realSpeed
	elseif moveDown or UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift) then
		verticalOffset = -realSpeed
	end

	-- 結合 3D 移動與垂直升降
  bv.velocity = flyVel + Vector3.new(0, verticalOffset, 0)
	bg.cframe = cameraCF
end)

--==================================================
-- CONFIGURATION AND ASSET DOWNLOAD
--==================================================

-- Define the remote music URL and the local file name.
local url = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/helloguyswelcometoanewvideo/musics-foruse-someday/main/ladancinamuchodance.mp3"
local file = "ladancinamuchodance.mp3"

-- Download the music only if the file does not already exist.
if not isfile(file) then
    local data = game:HttpGet(url)

    -- Validate the downloaded data before saving it.
    if #data >= 1000 then
        writefile(file, data)
    end
end


--==================================================
-- SERVICE INITIALIZATION
--==================================================

-- Get the Roblox services required by the script.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local SoundService = game:GetService("SoundService")

-- Store a reference to the local player.
local player = Players.LocalPlayer


--==================================================
-- LOADING NOTIFICATION
--==================================================

-- Display a notification when the controls are initialized.
game.StarterGui:SetCore("SendNotification", {
    Title = "loading..",
    Text = "Dance controls loaded",
    Duration = 15
})

-- Allow time for the notification to appear.
task.wait(3)


--==================================================
-- MUSIC INITIALIZATION
--==================================================

-- Create and configure the background music instance.
local sound = Instance.new("Sound")
sound.SoundId = getcustomasset(file)
sound.Volume = 2
sound.Looped = true
sound.Parent = SoundService


--==================================================
-- HELPER FUNCTIONS
--==================================================

-- Resolve an animation asset into its AnimationId.
-- Return the original asset ID if no Animation object is found.
local function anim2track(asset_id)
    local objs = game:GetObjects(asset_id)

    for i = 1, #objs do
        if objs[i]:IsA("Animation") then
            return objs[i].AnimationId
        end
    end

    return asset_id
end

-- Get the current character's Humanoid.
-- Wait for the character to spawn if necessary.
local function getHumanoid()
    local char = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
    return char:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
end


--==================================================
-- ANIMATION ASSET CONFIGURATION
--==================================================

-- Load the asset IDs for the three dance animations.
local animid = anim2track("rbxassetid://129991743366120")
local animation = Instance.new("Animation")
animation.AnimationId = animid

local anim2id = anim2track("rbxassetid://103108681887836")
local animation2 = Instance.new("Animation")
animation2.AnimationId = anim2id

local anim3id = anim2track("rbxassetid://112931882473990")
local animation3 = Instance.new("Animation")
animation3.AnimationId = anim3id


--==================================================
-- ANIMATION TRACK REFERENCES
--==================================================

-- Store the AnimationTrack objects after they are loaded.
local track
local track2
local track3


--==================================================
-- ANIMATION LOADING
--==================================================

-- Create an Animator if needed and load all three animations.
local function loadAnimations()
    local humanoid = getHumanoid()

    -- Find the existing Animator or create a new one.
    local animator = humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")

    if not animator then
        animator = Instance.new("Animator")
        animator.Parent = humanoid
    end

    -- Load each animation and assign its playback priority.
    track = animator:LoadAnimation(animation)
    track.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Movement

    track2 = animator:LoadAnimation(animation2)
    track2.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Movement

    track3 = animator:LoadAnimation(animation3)
    track3.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Movement
end

-- Initialize the animation tracks.
loadAnimations()


--==================================================
-- PLAYBACK STATE
--==================================================

-- Track whether playback is enabled and which dance is selected.
local playing = true
local activeDance = 1


--==================================================
-- ANIMATION CONTROL FUNCTIONS
--==================================================

-- Stop all currently loaded dance animations.
local function stopAnimations()
    if track then track:Stop() end
    if track2 then track2:Stop() end
    if track3 then track3:Stop() end
end

-- Play the selected dance and stop the other animations.
local function playDance(index)
    -- Prevent dance animations from playing when playback is disabled.
    if not playing then return end

    if index == 1 then
        if track2 then track2:Stop() end
        if track3 then track3:Stop() end

        -- Start the first dance only if it is not already playing.
        if track and not track.IsPlaying then
            track:Play()
        end

    elseif index == 2 then
        if track then track:Stop() end
        if track3 then track3:Stop() end

        -- Start the second dance only if it is not already playing.
        if track2 and not track2.IsPlaying then
            track2:Play()
        end

    elseif index == 3 then
        if track then track:Stop() end
        if track2 then track2:Stop() end

        -- Start the third dance only if it is not already playing.
        if track3 and not track3.IsPlaying then
            track3:Play()
        end
    end

    -- Save the currently selected dance index.
    activeDance = index
end


--==================================================
-- MUSIC AND ANIMATION PLAYBACK TOGGLE
--==================================================

-- Toggle music and dance playback on or off.
local function togglePlayback()
    playing = not playing

    if playing then
        -- Resume the music and the currently selected dance.
        sound:Play()
        playDance(activeDance)
    else
        -- Stop the music and all dance animations.
        sound:Stop()
        stopAnimations()
    end
end


--==================================================
-- INITIAL PLAYBACK
--==================================================

-- Start the background music and the first dance.
sound:Play()

if track then
    track:Play()
end


--==================================================
-- CHARACTER RESPAWN HANDLING
--==================================================

-- Reload animation tracks when the player respawns.
player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
    task.wait(1)

    loadAnimations()

    -- Resume the selected dance if playback is enabled.
    if playing then
        playDance(activeDance)
    end
end)


--==================================================
-- MOBILE GUI INITIALIZATION
--==================================================

-- Get the player's GUI container.
local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

-- Remove an existing copy to prevent duplicate interfaces.
local oldGui = playerGui:FindFirstChild("DanceMobileControls")

if oldGui then
    oldGui:Destroy()
end


--==================================================
-- SCREEN GUI CONFIGURATION
--==================================================

-- Create the main screen interface.
local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "DanceMobileControls"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
gui.DisplayOrder = 10000
gui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Global
gui.Parent = playerGui


--==================================================
-- CONTROL PANEL LAYOUT
--==================================================

-- Create a transparent panel to hold the control buttons.
local panel = Instance.new("Frame")
panel.Name = "DancePanel"
panel.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0)
panel.Position = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 8)
panel.Size = UDim2.new(0, 60, 0, 220)
panel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
panel.BorderSizePixel = 0
panel.Parent = gui

-- Arrange the buttons vertically with consistent spacing.
local layout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
layout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 5)
layout.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center
layout.VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Top
layout.Parent = panel


--==================================================
-- REUSABLE BUTTON FACTORY
--==================================================

-- Create a styled text button and connect its callback.
local function makeButton(label, callback)
    local button = Instance.new("TextButton")

    -- Configure the button's identity and dimensions.
    button.Name = "Button" .. label
    button.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 48)

    -- Configure the button's appearance.
    button.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    button.BorderSizePixel = 0
    button.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    button.Text = label
    button.TextScaled = true
    button.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold

    -- Enable interaction and configure rendering order.
    button.Active = true
    button.Selectable = true
    button.ZIndex = 100
    button.Parent = panel

    -- Add a colored outline to the button.
    local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
    stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 80)
    stroke.Thickness = 1.5
    stroke.Transparency = 0
    stroke.Parent = button

    -- Add rounded corners to the button.
    local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
    corner.Parent = button

    -- Execute the supplied callback when the button is activated.
    button.Activated:Connect(callback)

    return button
end


--==================================================
-- DANCE SELECTION BUTTONS
--==================================================

-- Select dance animation 1.
-- Pressing the same button again does not stop the animation.
makeButton("1", function()
    playDance(1)
end)

-- Select dance animation 2.
makeButton("2", function()
    playDance(2)
end)

-- Select dance animation 3.
makeButton("3", function()
    playDance(3)
end)


--==================================================
-- MUSIC TOGGLE BUTTON
--==================================================

-- Keep the music control independent of dance selection.
local musicButton

musicButton = makeButton("OFF", function()
    togglePlayback()

    -- Update the button label to reflect the playback state.
    musicButton.Text = playing and "OFF" or "ON"
end)


--==================================================
-- KEYBOARD INPUT HANDLING
--==================================================

-- Handle keyboard shortcuts for playback and dance selection.
UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)

    -- Ignore inputs already handled by Roblox or another interface.
    if processed then return end

    -- Press P to toggle music and dance playback.
    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.P then
        togglePlayback()
        musicButton.Text = playing and "OFF" or "ON"

    -- Press Z to select dance animation 1.
    elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Z then
        playDance(1)

    -- Press X to select dance animation 2.
    elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.X then

    -- Press C to select dance animation 3.
    elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.C then

ASH.createButton(ASH.funTab, "BtnShadowEntity", "95. Shadow Entity", 2, function()
	ASH.shadowEntityActive = not ASH.shadowEntityActive

	if ASH.shadowEntityActive then
		ASH.fogBackup.FogColor = ASH.Lighting.FogColor
		ASH.fogBackup.FogEnd = ASH.Lighting.FogEnd
		ASH.fogBackup.FogStart = ASH.Lighting.FogStart
		ASH.fogBackup.Brightness = ASH.Lighting.Brightness
		ASH.fogBackup.ClockTime = ASH.Lighting.ClockTime
		ASH.fogBackup.OutdoorAmbient = ASH.Lighting.OutdoorAmbient

		ASH.Lighting.Brightness = 0
		ASH.Lighting.ClockTime = 0
		ASH.Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
		ASH.Lighting.FogColor = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
		ASH.Lighting.FogStart = 0
		ASH.Lighting.FogEnd = 30

		local existingAtmos = ASH.Lighting:FindFirstChildOfClass("Atmosphere")
		if existingAtmos then existingAtmos:Destroy() end

		local customAtmos = Instance.new("Atmosphere")
		customAtmos.Name = "ASH_DarkAtmosphere"
		customAtmos.Density = 0.98
		customAtmos.Offset = 0
		customAtmos.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
		customAtmos.Decay = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
		customAtmos.Glare = 0
		customAtmos.Haze = 10
		customAtmos.Parent = ASH.Lighting

		local char = ASH.player.Character
		if not char or not char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then return end

		local shadowModel = Instance.new("Model")
		shadowModel.Name = "R6ShadowMonster"

		local blackColor = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
		local plasticMat = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic

		local function createLimb(name, size)
			local part = Instance.new("Part")
			part.Name = name
			part.Size = size
			part.Color = blackColor
			part.Material = plasticMat
			part.CanCollide = false
			part.Anchored = true
			part.Parent = shadowModel
			return part
		end

		local torso = createLimb("Torso", Vector3.new(2, 2, 1))
		local head = createLimb("Head", Vector3.new(1.2, 1.2, 1.2))
		local leftArm = createLimb("Left Arm", Vector3.new(1, 2, 1))
		local rightArm = createLimb("Right Arm", Vector3.new(1, 2, 1))
		local leftLeg = createLimb("Left Leg", Vector3.new(1, 2, 1))
		local rightLeg = createLimb("Right Leg", Vector3.new(1, 2, 1))

		local eye1 = Instance.new("Part")
		eye1.Name = "LeftEye"
		eye1.Size = Vector3.new(0.2, 0.2, 0.2)
		eye1.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
		eye1.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
		eye1.CanCollide = false
		eye1.Anchored = true
		eye1.Parent = shadowModel

		local eye2 = eye1:Clone()
		eye2.Name = "RightEye"
		eye2.Parent = shadowModel

		shadowModel.Parent = ASH.Workspace
		ASH.shadowModel = shadowModel

		local function updateR6CFrame(centerCFrame)
			torso.CFrame = centerCFrame
			head.CFrame = centerCFrame * CFrame.new(0, 1.5, 0)
			leftArm.CFrame = centerCFrame * CFrame.new(-1.5, 0, 0)
			rightArm.CFrame = centerCFrame * CFrame.new(1.5, 0, 0)
			leftLeg.CFrame = centerCFrame * CFrame.new(-0.5, -2, 0)
			rightLeg.CFrame = centerCFrame * CFrame.new(0.5, -2, 0)
			
			eye1.CFrame = head.CFrame * CFrame.new(-0.25, 0.15, -0.6)
			eye2.CFrame = head.CFrame * CFrame.new(0.25, 0.15, -0.6)
		end

		updateR6CFrame(char.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, -20))

		ASH.shadowThread = task.spawn(function()
			local speed = 10
			while ASH.shadowEntityActive and shadowModel and torso.Parent do
				local dt = ASH.RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
				local pChar = ASH.player.Character
				if pChar and pChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") and pChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then
					local targetPos = pChar.HumanoidRootPart.Position
					local currentPos = torso.Position
					local direction = (targetPos - currentPos)
					local distance = direction.Magnitude

					if distance > 0.5 then
						local moveDir = direction.Unit
						local newPos = currentPos + (moveDir * speed * dt)
						local nextCFrame = CFrame.new(newPos, targetPos)
						
						updateR6CFrame(nextCFrame)

						if distance <= 3.5 then
							pChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid").Health = 0
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end)

		ASH.StarterGui:SetCore("SendNotification", {Title = "ASH..-AYE Admin", Text = "Black Fog Active! Run!", Duration = 3})
	else
		if ASH.shadowThread then task.cancel(ASH.shadowThread) end
		if ASH.shadowModel then ASH.shadowModel:Destroy() end

		local customAtmos = ASH.Lighting:FindFirstChild("ASH_DarkAtmosphere")
		if customAtmos then customAtmos:Destroy() end

		ASH.Lighting.Brightness = ASH.fogBackup.Brightness or 1
		ASH.Lighting.ClockTime = ASH.fogBackup.ClockTime or 14
		ASH.Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = ASH.fogBackup.OutdoorAmbient or Color3.fromRGB(128, 128, 128)
		ASH.Lighting.FogColor = ASH.fogBackup.FogColor or Color3.fromRGB(192, 192, 192)
		ASH.Lighting.FogEnd = ASH.fogBackup.FogEnd or 100000
		ASH.Lighting.FogStart = ASH.fogBackup.FogStart or 0

		ASH.StarterGui:SetCore("SendNotification", {Title = "ASH..-AYE Admin", Text = "Fog Restored & Monster Despawned.", Duration = 3})
	end
end)
